### Shattuck Labs Announces Two Poster Presentations at UEG Week 2026


October 13, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/754780530/files/doc_news/Shattuck-Labs-Announces-Two-Poster-Presentations-at-UEG-Week-2026-2026.pdf)


AUSTIN, Texas and DURHAM, N.C., Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Shattuck Labs, Inc. (Shattuck or the Company) (NASDAQ: STTK), a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of potential first-in-class monoclonal and bispecific DR3 blocking antibodies for the treatment of patients with inflammatory and immune-mediated diseases, today announced two upcoming poster presentations at United European Gastroenterology (UEG) Week 2026, taking place October 17–20, 2026, in Barcelona, Spain.


**Presentation Details**


**Format:** Moderated poster presentation
**Title:** Development and Characterization of SL-846: A Half-Life Extended, Dual-Receptor (DR3 x IL23RA) Targeting Bispecific Antibody
**Presenter:** Mahmud Hussain, Ph.D., Director, R&D of Shattuck Labs
**Date/Time:** October 19, 2026; 1:00–2:00 p.m. CEST


**Format:** ePoster presentation
**Title:** Soluble TL1A/Anti-TL1A Immune Complexes Induce De Novo Production of TL1A and Induce Anti-Drug Antibodies That Cross-Bind Approved IBD Antibodies
**Presenter:** Suresh de Silva, Ph.D., Chief Scientific Officer of Shattuck Labs
**Date/Time:** October 17–20, 2026 (available for viewing throughout the congress)


The posters will be available under Events & Presentations in the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at[www.shattucklabs.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=CsvnSuQ-x5YX6ZVTy78o0TrxeXG2st5cTGbXCFK_rZRgsWd8PjFMgGE6q9-Lwn0byufcIoxAtCNVuF5rVtipIdAUV5mKaBhe4WixWmKd2D4=) following the congress.


**About Shattuck Labs, Inc.**
Shattuck Labs, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of potentially first-in-class monoclonal and bispecific DR3 blocking antibodies for the treatment of patients with inflammatory and immune-mediated diseases. Shattuck’s expertise in protein engineering and the development of novel TNF receptor therapeutics come together in its lead program, SL-325, a potentially first-in-class DR3 antagonist antibody designed to achieve a more complete blockade of the clinically validated DR3/TL1A pathway. The Company has offices in both Austin, Texas and Durham, North Carolina.
